fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: A spray across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Reek Bomb
fusions.desc: Hurls a foul bomb that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Left Alone
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Scent Mark
fusions.desc: When an enemy strikes you, a spray hits the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
